question: The Academic Bank of Credit (ABC) scheme, which was launched in ________________ 2021, aims at facilitating the academic mobility of students, giving them the freedom to study across the higher educational institutions in India with the help of a ‘credit scheme’ mechanism.
solution:
The correct answer is __**July**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Academic Bank of Credit (ABC)**

 
 
• The Academic Bank of Credit (ABC) scheme, which was launched in** July 2021**, aims at facilitating the **academic mobility of students, giving them the freedom to study across the higher educational institutions in India with the help of a ‘credit scheme’ mechanism**.
 
• The** National Education Policy (NEP) 2020** of the **Government of India** originally envisioned it as a **loan facility**.
 
• The ABC will be in charge of tasks including** opening, closing, and validating each student's individual academic account**.
 
• Additionally, it will be in charge of collecting the a**cademic credits that students have earned from their different higher education institutions, validating them, storing them, transferring or redeeming them, and disseminating them among its stakeholders** as and when necessary.
 
• The programme will cover all types of **graduate-level, postgraduate, PhD, diploma, certificate, and other courses **given by higher education institutions that are approved by the** University Grants Commission (UGC)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **ABC of India** will require students to **manually open an account**, followed by ABC's standard operating rules, and **provide a special ID that may be used to identify each student's account with the ABC**.
 
• Over** 290 of the best higher education institutions** in India** will join the bank** when it begins operations in the academic year **2021–2022**.
 
• All of the institutions that rank among the** top 100 according to the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) and all of the institutions that have received National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) "Grade A" **accreditation will be included in this group.
 
• Additionally,** SWAYAM, NPTEL, V-Lab, and other programmes** that provide their courses are qualified to use the services **offered by Academic Bank of Credit**.
